newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak central bank to simplify bank licencing.
newsitem.headline: Slovak central bank to simplify bank licencing.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Friday said it would propose an amendment to banking regulations to simplify licencing, putting branches of foreign banks on an equal footing with their domestic counterparts.

"The board has discussed the (part) of the law...which cancels a two-grade permissioning procedure (and) omits a requirement for an economic purposefulness assessment during the issuance of a (licence) to function as a bank," a statement issued after the board's regular meeting said.
"It equalises the position of Slovak and foreign entities during the issuance of (a licence) to establish a bank, or increase shares in the bank according to the law," the statement added.
It said the the law was in accordance with the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD) requirements.
No further details were included in the statement.
